description: The chart illustrates the effect of various language models across different language families, comparing the performance of mBERT and XLM models with different training configurations. The horizontal axis represents the language family categories, labeled as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each language family category is represented by a group of six bars, corresponding to the models mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2, colored light blue, dark blue, light green, dark green, light red, and dark red, respectively. The bars display the effect values, accompanied by black error bars indicating the range of variation. The effect values vary across language families and models, with IE-Indic showing the highest values, around 15-20 for mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2, and Isolate showing the lowest values, around 0-2 for most models. The bars within each group are not sorted in a specific order, but the models are consistently represented in the same order across all language families.
